title: Policy analytics
description: Recharts dashboard: decisions over time (stacked area chart), most-hit rules (bar chart), eval latency trends (line chart). Export-ready for compliance reports.
definitionOfDone: Decisions over time: Recharts stacked area chart (allow/deny/approve/throttle)
Most-hit rules: Recharts horizontal bar chart
Eval latency trends: Recharts line chart (p50, p95, p99)
Export button (CSV download of chart data)

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/components/policy/PolicyAnalytics.tsx: Recharts dashboard. (1) Decisions over time: StackedAreaChart with 4 series (allow, deny, require_approval, throttle) using decision-type colors. Time axis. (2) Most-hit rules: Horizontal BarChart, sorted by hit count, showing rule ID + bar. Top 10 rules. (3) Eval latency trends: LineChart with 3 series (p50, p95, p99) over time. Time range selector: buttons for 1h, 24h, 7d, 30d. Data from GET /api/v1/policy/stats?range=X. Export button: generates CSV from chart data (builds CSV string, triggers browser download via Blob URL). All charts use ResponsiveContainer for responsive sizing.
implementationPlan.note: Created PolicyAnalytics with 3 Recharts charts: stacked AreaChart for decisions over time (allow/deny/require_approval/throttle), horizontal BarChart for top 10 most-hit rules, LineChart for p50/p95/p99 eval latency. Time range selector (1h/24h/7d/30d), CSV export for all chart data, custom tooltips.
